control.note: The M7 stage interval includes host submission/boundary gaps between target leaves; immediate per-leaf markers intentionally exclude those gaps.

subroles.disposition: not arithmetic; retain for P5/M2 submission analysis

vulkan_component_accounting.source: /tmp/d08-m3/q4-vulkan-perf.log measured prefill block; quant and matrix shapes disambiguate each role

selected_owner.why: largest measured leaf gap after splitting the combined residual group; unlike QKV, the route has not already received an exact-role sole-resident repair

frozen_candidate_budget.tuning_dimension: sole resident layout plus its existing bulk/small-row consumer chain

candidates.name: sole Q4T16 native
candidates.operational: direct c1, rowtile c2-c4, independently choose direct or WMMA at c8

candidates.name: sole Q4T16 source-F16/rocBLAS
candidates.bulk: f16_rocblas_t16_bf16_bf16_out with existing exact adjacent-pair producer
candidates.arithmetic: changed association; screen only if exact T16 c1-c8 guards pass but native bulk misses continuation, then require the full category quality gate

frozen_candidate_budget.leaf_continue: >=1.10x selected gate leaf and >=1% projected request saving with finite output and >=90% top-1
frozen_candidate_budget.operational_guard: sole resident must be non-regressive at c1/c2/c4/c8; no pack8 sidecar
frozen_candidate_budget.full_model_budget: best qualifying candidate only; one combined eager+production-graph A/B and complete category/heldout correctness gate
frozen_candidate_budget.stop: reject on any operational regression, correctness failure, duplicate residency, or <1% complete-wall projection
